notes: Only labels in standalone_cell_verification meet the prompt requirement for a standalone whole-cell occurrence. Remaining labels were inferred by complete unambiguous segmentation of recurring concatenated values; they are not independently confirmed form options.
Staff and Housemate appear to be target subchoices inside the behavioral field; confirm form hierarchy before treating them as event types.
Observed labels are not an exhaustive catalog of unselected PHS options.
Other Event Types values not confidently recognized as categories are conservatively counted as narrative, including one repeated short phrase.
Counts are event rows containing a label, counted once per row. unsplittable_examples_count counts affected rows, excluding blanks.
Value arrays for the four single-select columns contain objects with label and rows so counts are retained.

Mobile Crisis Services indicates service involvement, not proof a telephone call occurred. Behavioral Crisis requiring crisis intervention indicates a crisis event; 911 Call does not specifically imply a behavioral crisis call.

The mixed reportable-behavior option can mean aggression OR self-injury and is therefore excluded from a definitive self-injury mapping. The mixed Other self-injury/disruptive category is included as a broad flag, not a confirmed self-injury event.

Psychiatric Admission (for observation) including in an acute care hospital is an observation/admission flag and does not by itself prove inpatient status. Medical Events was not included in the requested option extraction, so the hospitalization mapping is incomplete for medical admissions.
No property-damage option was recovered from the requested fields. An empty mapping does not mean zero property-damage events.
The source XLSX contained an empty fill element. A valid empty patternFill was substituted only in an in-memory copy to allow openpyxl to read it; source values and source file were unchanged.
